name: How long does it take to fix a toilet base leak?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to fix a toilet base leak?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most standard toilet base leak repairs, such as replacing a wax ring and resealing the toilet, can typically be completed within 1 to 2 hours. This timeframe includes draining the toilet, removing it, replacing the old seal, and reinstalling it properly. More complex issues, like repairing subfloor damage or replacing a cracked toilet, will naturally take longer. Our plumbers work efficiently to minimize disruption.
